rules.justification: Bitwise: random internal values are draws of the replicated libstdc++ engine/distributions (D-006, NV section 12 R0) in the replicated upstream allocation order; a single different draw or order shifts every later value.
rules.evidence: 2026-11-10: crates/akantu-model/tests/random_internal_matches_oracle.rs compares every value bit for bit (516 values, 7 steps) and the 4 next engine values (macOS arm64); x86_64 Linux reproduced by an independent review; smm_2d_mixed (x86_64 oracle): 72 values and the next 4 engine values, bitwise; x86_64 Linux: replay by an independent review; regenerated smm_2d (79/79 arrays) and smm_2d_mixed (13/13) on the x86_64 oracle, byte-identical in 3 runs
rules.reviewed_by: independent review during the port, November 2026
